name: Petramyces lithophagus
story: The slowest thing here, at the engine's lower limit: five micrometres an hour through mineral soil, in a mat so dense it is nearly solid, and it almost never gives a hypha up. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the ECM-S family.
